title: The reducing registers number the same as the tubulins in an Orch OR event

statements.text: The number of quantum gravity registers that reduce at the end of inflation, about $10^9$, equals the number of superposed tubulin qubits that undergo orchestrated objective reduction in a human conscious event.

sources.quote: This is also the number of superposed tubulins-qubits in our brain, which undergo the Penrose-Hameroff’s Orchestrated Objective Reduction, (Orch OR), leading to a conscious event
